5.instruction: Place the brown round 2x2 brick on top of the green half-circle plate, near its straight edge.
watchFor: Keep the brick on the studs near the flat edge, not the curved edge.

5.instruction: Attach the second green half-circle plate to the first, forming a full circle around the brown brick.
watchFor: Flat edges must meet so the two halves make a full circle.

6.instruction: Attach four dark green 2x2 slope bricks around the center of the green round plate, sloping outward.
watchFor: Slopes face outward from the center, with the studs toward the middle.
Keep the brown center pieces uncovered.

7.instruction: Place the tan 4x4 round plate on top of the green base, over the dark green slopes.
watchFor: Center it over the dark green slopes so it sits flat.

7.instruction: Attach the reddish-brown round 2x2 brick on top, pressing it onto the brown pieces on the tan plate.
watchFor: Brown posts must line up with the round brick's underside before pressing down.

8.instruction: Place the tan round 2x2 tile with hole on top of the reddish-brown round 2x2 brick.
watchFor: The tile sits flat on top, covering the studs.

8.instruction: Slide the long gray axle into the brown connector, then push the connector into the round brick's hole.
watchFor: Check the axle length against the 1:1 size guide at top.
Connector end sticks out below the brick.

9.instruction: Slide the brown round brick onto the grey bars, then attach the brown branch piece at the far end.
watchFor: Line up the branch piece's pegs with the open holes on the bars.

9.instruction: Slide the brown round brick onto the grey bars, then add the dark grey round plate at the end.
watchFor: Keep the brown branch pegs facing the same way as in step 8.

9.instruction: Push the finished brown tower down onto the center of the green round base.
watchFor: Press the tower in until it sits flat on the tan ring.

10.instruction: Attach the two brown branch pieces to the tree trunk, then press the green leaf piece onto the right side.
watchFor: Brown branches go on the left side of the trunk, one higher than the other.
The leaf piece snaps onto the stud on the right.

11.instruction: Place the previously built white ring sub-assembly with its black and pink round pieces flat in front of you.

parts.name: previous sub-build (white ring with black and pink studs)

watchFor: Keep the black and pink round pieces in the positions shown.

11.instruction: Add four yellow round 1x1 plates onto the studs of the white ring build.
watchFor: Place the yellow plates on the studs as shown, in the center cluster.

12.instruction: Press a magenta curved slope onto each of four white clip plates, then attach each pair to the model's sides.
watchFor: Attach the clip plates to the model's clips in the direction of the arrows.
Make sure the curved slopes face outward.

12.instruction: Press a light pink curved piece onto each of four white clip plates, then attach them around the model.
watchFor: The pink pieces cover both studs of the white plate.
Place each assembly on the matching side of the model.

13.instruction: Press the tan plate with side clips onto the dark green curved plate.
watchFor: Clips point to the left side.

13.instruction: Place the black round plate on top of the tan plate.
watchFor: Keep the clips facing left.

13.instruction: Turn the build over, then attach it to the center of the pink flower build.
watchFor: Rotate the model as the arrow shows before attaching.

13.instruction: Attach the pink flower build to the brown tree trunk on the green base.
watchFor: Align the flower with the tree trunk as the arrow shows.

14.instruction: Take the white web-shaped piece with four black studs and set it down as the base for the build.

parts.name: White web piece with black round studs

watchFor: Keep the four black studs facing up.

14.instruction: Press four magenta round 1x1 plates onto the four black studs of the web piece.
watchFor: Place one plate on each black stud.

15.instruction: Attach a lavender curved slope to each of four white clip plates, then add all four to the legs of the model.
watchFor: Press each slope onto the plate's stud before attaching the clip plate to the model.

15.instruction: Attach a magenta curved brick to each of four white clip plates, then add them to the model between the legs.
watchFor: Each magenta piece covers both studs of its plate.
Attach them in the gaps between the lavender legs.

16.instruction: Start with the dark green curved slope piece, studs facing up.
watchFor: Check the slope's orientation before adding the next piece.

16.instruction: Place the tan clip plate on the green slope, then press the black round plate on top.
watchFor: Clips stick out to the left and right sides.
Red arrows show the black plate goes on the two studs.

16.instruction: Flip the part over, then attach it by its clips to the center of the model.
watchFor: Rotate the model as the arrow icon shows before attaching.
Clips on the sub-build snap onto the center of the build.

17.instruction: Attach the pink and white flying figure sub-build to the brown tree trunk arm, following the arrow from the left.
watchFor: Rotate the model as the turn icon shows to see the connection point.
Connect the figure's tan hand to the brown branch tip above the trunk.

18.instruction: Place the lime green leaf-stem plate flat as the base of the flower.
watchFor: Build this whole step twice.

18.instruction: Press a magenta flower petal onto the end stud of the green stem, then add a second petal on top.
watchFor: Petals stack on the stud at the right end of the stem.

18.instruction: Press the yellow round 1x1 plate onto the center stud of the magenta petals.
watchFor: Build this whole step twice.

19.instruction: Attach the sub-build from the previous page onto the brown trunk, connecting it at the two arrow points.
watchFor: Line up both arrows with the dark brown connection points on the lime green branches.

20.instruction: Attach the dark gray angled connector onto the blue pin sticking out of the top of the tree trunk.
watchFor: Push the connector straight down onto the blue pin, keeping its orientation as shown by the arrow.

21.instruction: Push the dark gray joint connector down onto the top end of the dark gray axle, then repeat to make two.
watchFor: Build this assembly twice (2x shown at top).
Axle is length 4; check it against the 1:1 size guide.

21.instruction: Attach the small dark gray connector piece to the side of the joint on the axle assembly.
watchFor: Match the connector's angle to the picture.

22.instruction: Slide a yellow round piece onto the gray axle connector, then build two of these.
watchFor: Build two identical assemblies (2x).

22.instruction: Attach both gray axle assemblies to the top of the flower build, pushing them in where the arrows point.
watchFor: Both axles go in upright, with the yellow rings at the top.

23.instruction: Push the gray pin into the center hole of the brown three-way connector, from above.
watchFor: Insert the pin into the center hole facing up, as the red arrow shows.

23.instruction: Attach the lime green leaf piece onto the center pin of the brown connector.
watchFor: Keep the connector in the same orientation as the previous step.

23.instruction: Insert two black axle pieces into the two open arms of the brown connector.
watchFor: Place one in the right arm and one in the lower-left arm.

24.instruction: Attach two reddish-brown 1x1 cones to the ends of the branch pieces, one on the right and one on the lower left.
watchFor: Cones point outward from the branch ends.

24.instruction: Attach two lime-green leaf plates to the branch, one on the lower left and one on the right end.
watchFor: Match each leaf's angle to the picture.

25.instruction: Attach a lime green leaf piece to the green branch end on the brown tree branch assembly.
watchFor: Do both leaf pieces, one on each branch end as shown.

25.instruction: Slide the brown tree branch assembly onto the two gray posts on top of the flower base.
watchFor: Line up both gray connectors with the yellow-ringed posts before pushing.

26.instruction: Attach four black claws to four gray clip pieces, then press the clips onto the two gray bars on the tree.
watchFor: Claws point downward when attached to the clips on the bars.
Press each clip onto the bar ends, two on each bar.

27.instruction: Push the brown cone piece onto the left end of the gray connector at the top of the flower tree.
watchFor: Attach it to the left-pointing gray connector end, not the branch on the right.

28.instruction: Place the yellow inverted slope piece with its two studded corners facing up as the base.
watchFor: Slope is upside down with the cutout in the middle

28.instruction: Press the two yellow axle-hole bricks into the middle of the slope piece.
watchFor: Axle holes face the front

28.instruction: Add the orange plate on the right of the studs and the yellow clip plate on the left.
watchFor: Clip opens toward the left end

28.instruction: Slide the black axle through the axle holes so it sticks out evenly on both sides.
watchFor: Center the axle with equal length on each side

29.instruction: Attach the small yellow piece on the right to the side of the yellow brick assembly using the black pin.
watchFor: Push the pin fully into the side hole of the yellow brick.
Keep the two upright clips on top of the yellow brick facing up.

29.instruction: Place the finished yellow assembly on top of the two grey claw pieces on the flower stand.
watchFor: Line up both yellow rings with the grey claws below.

30.instruction: Attach the white bracket brick to the back end of the yellow 2x4 plate, with its side studs facing right.
watchFor: Side studs of the white bracket face right
Bracket sits at the right end of the plate

30.instruction: Attach two yellow side-stud bricks to the front of the white bracket, with their side studs facing right.
watchFor: Side studs face right, matching the white bracket

31.instruction: Attach the white stud-sided brick to the right end of the yellow and white build.

parts.name: White brick with studs on sides

watchFor: Side studs face outward on the right and front, matching the picture.

31.instruction: Place the red round plate and the blue plate on top of the build, blue at the back right.
watchFor: Red round plate sits at the front left; blue plate goes behind and to the right.

32.instruction: Place the light blue 1x2 plate on top of the orange 1x2 plate at the back of the build.
watchFor: Align the plate over the two studs of the orange plate, not the blue brick below.

32.instruction: Place the pink 2x3 brick on the build, then add the red round 2x2 plate on top.
watchFor: Pink brick covers the red plate and sits on the front; red plate goes on its right studs.

33.instruction: Press the orange 1x2 plate onto the gray clip plate, covering both studs.
watchFor: Clip faces the front-left as shown.

33.instruction: Attach the white back plate on top of the orange plate, with its tall back on the right.
watchFor: Tall back sits on the right side.

33.instruction: Add the light blue plate on top, then press a second gray clip plate above it, clip facing left.
watchFor: Keep both clips on the left side.

33.instruction: Attach the finished clip sub-build onto the top of the model where the arrow points.
watchFor: Align it on the top right of the model as shown.

34.instruction: Attach the small blue tile and the long blue tile to the side of the build, along its right edge.
watchFor: The long tile goes upright along the right side; the short tile goes at the bottom.

34.instruction: Place two blue 1x1 bricks with side studs side by side on top of the red round plate, at the top.
watchFor: Side studs face right, toward the front of the model.

35.instruction: Attach the white brick with studs on all sides onto the front left of the build, beside the yellow section.

parts.name: white brick with studs on sides

watchFor: Side studs must face outward, matching the picture.

35.instruction: Rotate the model, then place the medium blue tile and the long blue tile on the side of the build.
watchFor: Turn the model as the rotation arrow shows before adding tiles.
Short tile and long tile go in different spots.

36.instruction: Place a light blue 2x4 plate on top of the previous build.
watchFor: Light blue plate is a different shade from the medium blue plate in step 52.

36.instruction: Place a medium blue 2x4 plate on top, lined up with the plate below.
watchFor: Line up all studs with the plate underneath.

36.instruction: Attach a dark blue 2x2 plate with side studs at the right end, side studs pointing right.

parts.name: Dark blue 2x2 plate with side studs

watchFor: Side studs face right, toward the end of the build.

37.instruction: Add the light blue 2x4 plate on top of the stack, covering the existing light blue layers.
watchFor: Line up the plate with the layers below; the dark blue section stays at the right end.

37.instruction: Place the black round 2x2 plate on the left studs, then the blue curved slope on top.
watchFor: Put the round plate on the left end of the build.
The curved slope sits on top, with its stepped edge facing front.

38.instruction: Place the blue curved slope on top of the blue 1x2 brick, then set it onto the blue sub-build below.
watchFor: Curve of the slope must face the same direction as the curved shell below.

38.instruction: Attach the finished blue curved shell to the left side of the multicolored build.
watchFor: Keep the shell's curved side facing outward to the left.

39.instruction: Place an orange curved slope on the end of a pink 1x4 plate.
watchFor: Build this sub-assembly twice.

39.instruction: Attach a blue 2x4 plate on top of the pink plate, beside the orange slope.
watchFor: Pink plate stays visible along the front edge.

39.instruction: Add a second orange curved slope next to the first so both sit across the top.
watchFor: Make two identical assemblies, one for each side.

39.instruction: Attach one assembly to each side of the white and pink body, at the arrows.
watchFor: Orange slopes curve outward on both sides.

40.instruction: Place the orange 2x2 plate with a corner cut, ready to build the yellow wing piece.
watchFor: Check the plate's cut corner points the way shown.

40.instruction: Attach a yellow curved slope piece onto the orange plate, overhanging the plate's back edge.
watchFor: Leave two orange studs visible at the left.

40.instruction: Join the second yellow curved slope to the first, then press the finished piece onto the right side of the model.
watchFor: The orange plate sits under the yellow slopes; the arrow shows the target on the model's right side.

40.instruction: Attach the finished yellow-orange wing assembly to the right side of the model, as the arrow shows.
watchFor: Line it up with the two white studs on top.

41.instruction: Attach the finished blue and yellow balloon sub-build onto the yellow pin connector at the top of the flower stem.
watchFor: Blue half of the balloon goes on the left, orange and yellow half on the right.

42.instruction: Place the round light blue 4x4 plate with the studs facing up. It will be built upside down for now.
watchFor: The plate is shown with its underside up, so the holes face you.

42.instruction: Attach the green round plate and the blue 2x8 plate to the light blue round plate, with the blue plate pointing left.
watchFor: The blue plate extends to the left from the round plate.
The green round plate sits on the right end of the blue plate.

43.instruction: Turn the build over, then attach the dark blue quarter-round plate and the medium blue 2x4 plate to the underside.
watchFor: Flip the model first, as the rotate icon shows
Round edge of the quarter plate faces outward, as in the picture

43.instruction: Place the dark blue curved slope on the left and the medium blue 1x4 tile on top of the plates.
watchFor: Curved slope sticks out past the left edge
Tile lies across the right end of the slope

44.instruction: Add a light blue 2x3 plate and a 2x4 blue plate on top of the build, then a small curved slope at the front.
watchFor: Place the small curved piece at the front right end of the plates.

44.instruction: Place a light blue curved slope on the front right, then lay a long blue 1x4 tile on top.
watchFor: Keep the tile aligned along the length of the build.

45.instruction: Attach three light blue 1x1 round-corner plates (tiles) onto the top of the front of the build.
watchFor: Place the rounded corners facing outward at the front end

45.instruction: Attach two blue 1x4 tiles on top of the build, on the right side behind the studs.
watchFor: The model is rotated; the tail now points to the left

46.instruction: Attach the blue curved slope piece along the left side of the build, next to the existing blue curved piece.
watchFor: Match the curve direction with the neighboring blue curved piece.

46.instruction: Add the small blue angled piece and the small blue rounded plate onto the front left of the build.
watchFor: Check the angled piece's orientation before pressing it down.

47.instruction: Press the gray ball-joint pin into the green round plate on the blue wing assembly, then flip the model over.
watchFor: Rotate the model as the arrow icon shows before the next step.

47.instruction: Attach the blue wing assembly to the yellow bird body by pushing its ball joint into the socket on top of the body.
watchFor: Line the wing up with the socket on the bird's back, as the arrow shows.

48.instruction: Place one orange 2x8 plate flat as the base of the new build.
watchFor: Keep the plate flat with the studs facing up.

48.instruction: Attach the blue curved slope at the far right end of the orange plate.
watchFor: Curve rises toward the outer right end.

48.instruction: Place the light blue 2x8 plate on top of the orange plate, next to the blue slope.
watchFor: Orange plate should stick out slightly under the blue plate.

49.instruction: Attach the left and right orange wing plates to the front of the blue and orange assembly.
watchFor: Make sure the left and right wedge plates go on the matching sides.

49.instruction: Press the two yellow 1x2 plates with clips onto the orange front studs, clips facing outward.
watchFor: Keep the clips facing the front and outward.

50.instruction: Add the light blue 1x2 plate, the medium blue 2x4 plate and the dark blue wedge plate onto the wing assembly.
watchFor: Place the light blue 1x2 plate at the rear, on the left end.
Make sure the wedge plate points the same way as in the picture.

50.instruction: Place the curved blue slope on the rear and the long flat blue tile across the top of the wing.
watchFor: Leave the studs at the right end uncovered.

51.instruction: Place the 1x round yellow plate on the end of the orange and blue wing piece.
watchFor: Put it on the wide end of the orange section, over the studs.

51.instruction: Attach the finished blue wing to the side of the parrot body at the arrow.
watchFor: Check the wing's orientation. The yellow clip connects at the arrow point.
Rotate the model to match the picture.

52.instruction: Place the light blue round 4x4 plate upside down, studs facing down, as the new base.
watchFor: Plate is shown flipped, with studs pointing down.

52.instruction: Attach the blue 2x6 plate and green round 2x2 plate onto the light blue round plate, extending to the lower left.
watchFor: The blue plate extends toward the lower left, with the green round plate over the base's upper right.

53.instruction: Turn the model over, then attach the blue quarter-circle plate and the light blue 2x4 plate to the existing build.
watchFor: Turn the model over as the rotate icon shows before adding the plates.
The light blue plate goes next to the round light blue plate.

53.instruction: Attach the blue curved slope to the left of the build and the light blue 1x4 tile on top.
watchFor: The curved slope points toward the lower left.
The tile sits on top of the plates, over the slope's back end.

54.instruction: Add a light blue 2x3 plate and a medium blue 2x4 plate on top of the fin build.
watchFor: Place the medium blue plate on the left and the light blue plate beside it toward the round end.

54.instruction: Press the light blue curved slope and the small light blue wedge tile onto the studs at the round end.
watchFor: The red arrows show the slope landing on the two studs near the round end.

55.instruction: Place two medium blue 1x4 tiles on top of the blue wing build, along the studded section.
watchFor: Line the tiles up with the studs on the build's top surface.

55.instruction: Attach three small light blue curved slope pieces onto the studs at the rounded front end of the wing.
watchFor: Check the curve direction matches the rounded end of the build.

56.instruction: Add the blue wedge plate and the small blue rounded plate onto the top of the ship body.
watchFor: Wedge plate points toward the front of the ship

56.instruction: Place the curved blue slope on the left and the long light-blue tile over the studs on top.
watchFor: Tile covers the studs on the right side only

57.instruction: Flip the blue wing sub-build over and press the gray ball-joint pin into the green round piece at its end.
watchFor: Check the rotate icon: turn the build to match the picture before adding the pin.

57.instruction: Attach the finished blue wing assembly to the model, sliding it in from the left as the arrow shows.
watchFor: The wing must go on in the arrow's direction, aligned with the pieces on the main build.

58.instruction: Press the orange 2x2 plate onto the two studs of the small yellow-orange 1x2 plate.
watchFor: The 2x2 plate sits on top, over the 1x2 plate's two studs.

58.instruction: Attach the blue 2x4 plate to the orange 2x2 stack, overlapping its left end.
watchFor: The blue plate overhangs to the upper left of the orange stack.

58.instruction: Place the blue slope on the left and press the orange 2x2 plate on top of the orange studs.
watchFor: The slope's high end faces the orange plates, with the slope falling away to the left.

59.instruction: Attach two blue 1x1 bricks with side studs to the back of the blue wedge, studs facing sideways.
watchFor: Side studs face outward to the left.

59.instruction: Place a light blue 1x2 plate on top of the two side-stud bricks.
watchFor: Cover both side-stud bricks.

59.instruction: Add an orange 1x2 brick on the orange stack and a light blue 1x2 plate on the blue part.
watchFor: Orange brick sits on the orange stack, not the blue.

59.instruction: Place an orange 1x2 brick on the orange stack, then a yellow curved 1x2 slope on top.
watchFor: Curve of the yellow slope faces the outer side.

60.instruction: Place the black round 2x2 plate onto the brown 1x2 jumper plate.
watchFor: Round plate sits on the brown plate's studs

60.instruction: Add a white rounded 1x2 plate and a black plate on the round base.
watchFor: Match the white and black positions shown

60.instruction: Add two white 1x2 plates on the front and right sides.
watchFor: Keep the black studs visible at the back

60.instruction: Place a black plate on top of the white pieces.
watchFor: Check which side the black plate sits on

60.instruction: Add a white rounded plate, then a black plate on top.
watchFor: Press the red-arrow plate straight down

60.instruction: Attach the finished white and black build to the brown plate on the blue and orange model.
watchFor: Follow the black arrow to the brown plate

61.instruction: Add two blue curved slope bricks on top of the build, near the back of the white section.
watchFor: Curve faces the same direction as the blue arch behind it.

61.instruction: Attach two white bricks with studs on their sides onto the white front of the build.

parts.name: white 1x1 brick with studs on sides

watchFor: Side studs face outward to the front and right.

62.instruction: Attach the round black-and-white piece to the side of the white block on the model, following the red arrow.

parts.name: Round 1x1 plate with white center (black ring)

watchFor: Two of these pieces are provided; this step places one, with the other going on the opposite side later or in another step.

63.instruction: Place the white 2x2 plate flat as the base of the penguin head sub-build.
Add the black 1x2 plate on the left side of the white plate.
watchFor: Keep two studs of the white plate exposed on the right.

63.instruction: Place the white 1x2 rounded plate on the left studs of the base.
Attach the black curved slope on the right, then press the black round 1x1 plate on top.
watchFor: Slope curves down toward the right and front.

63.instruction: Attach the finished head sub-build to the front of the penguin body, following the arrow.
watchFor: Face the eyes and beak toward the front.

64.instruction: Place the green 2x2 round plate on the front studs, then press the teal 2x2 tile on top.
watchFor: The tile covers the two blue studs and the round plate's rear studs, as the arrows show.

64.instruction: Attach the two light green curved slopes on the front of the green round plate, one on each side.
watchFor: Curved edges face outward and forward.

65.instruction: Attach the finished blue wing assembly to the left side of the parrot's body, following the arrow.
watchFor: Wing comes from the previous page's sub-build; press it on the side where the arrow points.
